question: As per National Statistics office, the work population ratio (WPR) in India is at ________ for july 2020 - June 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**39.8%.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Worker Population Ratio (WPR):** It expanded from **38.2%** in the earlier year to **39.8%**.
 
• The Laborer Populace Proportion (WPR) has expanded to** 52.6 percent in 2020-21** from 46.8 percent in 2017-18, said Association serve Jitendra
 
• Singh on Thursday in a composed answer to an inquiry in Rajya Sabha.
 
• India Laborer Populace Proportion information accounted for** 34.70 % in 2018.**
 
• The provincial regions recorded a joblessness pace of **3.3%** and metropolitan regions recorded a joblessness pace of** 6.7%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The joblessness rate in the nation expanded strongly to **6.1%**, according to the Occasional Workforce Overview** 2017-18 i**nformation, from** 2.2%**, in light of the Public Example Study,** 68th cycle, 2011-12.**
 
• The specialist populace proportion is characterized as the quantity of utilized individuals per thousand individuals. **WPR** = number of utilized individuals duplicated by 1000/complete populace The Laborer Populace Proportion is a pointer used to survey the country's business circumstance.
 
• The Workforce, as per Current Week by week Status (CWS), is the number of people either utilized or jobless on a normal in seven days going before the date of the study.
 
• The movement rate is **28.9%**. The movement rate among ladies was** 48% and 47.8%** in provincial and metropolitan regions, separately.
